## What are you trying to do?

## Environment

Share only non-sensitive details such as app version or commit, operating system,
and device model. Do not include serial numbers, account information, API keys,
recordings, transcripts, device identifiers, private endpoints, or production logs.

## Security note

Do not report vulnerabilities here. Follow [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Nomily-Ai/nomily-app/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
